_about: Bedlam Arena: the PvP lobby (25000), the five duel rooms (25001-25005) and the gallery (25006) are left to arena.py; the hazard rooms around them hold pit gladiators, arena lions and the champion of the arena in the fire circle, all sentinel so they never wander into a duel.
no_boss: the PvP arena: its champion is an elite, the duels are the real fights

25090.room_desc: A pit-fighter's gladius lies here in the sand.
25090.description: A short, broad stabbing sword with a bone grip worn dark by sweat, the arena's mark stamped at the hilt.

25091.room_desc: A bronze gladiator's helm lies here.
25091.description: A full bronze helm with a broad brim and a grille of crossed bars over the face, crested with a stiff red plume.

25092.room_desc: A small clay jar of salve lies here.
25092.description: A clay jar of greasy yellow salve that smells of pine tar and honey. The arena's cut-men smear it into wounds between bouts.

25093.room_desc: A lion-skin cloak lies here, its maned head still on it.
25093.description: The tawny hide of an arena lion, its maned head worn as a hood and its forepaws knotted at the throat.

25094.room_desc: A champion's gilded trident lies here.
25094.description: A long trident with gilded tines and a shaft wrapped in red leather, carried by the arena's reigning champion. The crowd roars at the sight of it.

25095.short_desc: a fat purse of arena winnings
25095.room_desc: A fat purse of coins lies here.
25095.description: A heavy leather purse of gold and silver, a champion's share of a season's wagers.

25010.name: gladiator pit fighter
25010.long_desc: A pit gladiator rolls his shoulders here, waiting for the next bout.
25010.description: A scarred fighter in a leather harness and greaves, a short sword in one fist and a net over his shoulder. He fights for the crowd and for his freedom, and he does not care whom.

25011.name: lion arena maned
25011.long_desc: An arena lion paces the sand, lashing its tail.
25011.description: A great maned lion kept hungry for the games, its hide criss-crossed with old scars from spear and whip.

25012.name: champion arena gladiator
25012.long_desc: The champion of the arena stands in the ring of fire, raising a gilded trident to an unseen crowd.
25012.description: A towering gladiator in gilded scale, his arms ringed with the bronze bands of every bout he has won. He has not lost in the Bedlam Arena in seven seasons.
